visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a screen displaying an anime character with green hair dressed in a green robe. In the foreground, several small figurines and a banana-shaped toy are visible on a desk. (2) A woman with dark, curly hair suddenly appears, holding a large magnifying glass up to her right eye, which is greatly magnified. She looks directly into the camera lens with a curious expression. (3) The camera focuses on a computer monitor showing the Netflix user profile interface. A mouse cursor is used to navigate to the 'Manage Profiles' section and select a specific user account. (4) The visual transitions to the 'Subtitle Appearance' settings menu on the computer screen. Various options for font size, color, and background are displayed and adjusted. (5) The screen returns to the Netflix homepage, and the show 'The Apothecary Diaries' is selected and played. (6) The anime scene plays again, but now the white subtitles are extremely large, covering a significant portion of the lower frame. The woman from earlier reappears in the foreground, leaning towards the screen with a look of exaggerated shock, comparing the giant text to her head size.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a brief sample of Japanese anime dialogue featuring a high-pitched female voice. (2) This is immediately followed by the main speaker's voice, a female with a bright and energetic tone, posing a question about Netflix subtitles in Mandarin. An upbeat, medium-tempo electronic BGM swells in the background. (3) A series of instructional phrases are delivered at a rapid, articulate pace as the speaker describes navigating the Netflix interface. Subtle digital UI click sounds are audible during the tutorial section. (4) The speaker's arousal level increases as she moves to the demonstration phase, her voice rising in pitch. (5) As the large subtitles appear, the speaker lets out an excited exclamation 'Oh!' followed by a loud, high-pitched shout 'Wow! It's too big!', punctuated by the energetic BGM which remains constant until the end of the clip.
